# Evercraft public AI discovery index

Evercraft exposes public, machine-readable capabilities for AI assistants and agents.

## Start here

Universal CHUM manifest:
- /.well-known/evercraft-chum.json

Plain-language deterministic resolver:
- GET /chum/resolve?q=<plain-language-problem>

Current public sell-now offers:
- /.well-known/evercraft-offers.json

Full public product directory:
- /.well-known/evercraft-products.json

Forge capability manifest:
- /.well-known/evercraft-capabilities.json

OpenAPI:
- /openapi.json

JSON-LD:
- /schema.jsonld

Human-readable AI discovery page:
- /ai-discovery.html

## Commercial state

The public offer catalog currently distinguishes payment-ready from quote-ready offers. Never treat quote-ready as payment-ready.

Payment-ready examples currently include:
- ROASTED 99¢ Text Pressure Test: $0.99 one-time
- FindMyPart: $19 / $49 / $99 one-time hunts
- Career Command Interview Sprint: $19 one-time
- EventWave: $49 Event Boost / $149 Venue Pack
- Evercraft Deck Engine Founding Capital Fit Sprint: $49 one-time
- FAIE: $250 Signal Brief / $2,500 Proof Sprint
- AliEV: $299 Preliminary / $750 Full Site Report, plus other verified handoff offers
- Systemia Website Audit: free preview / $500 Complete Audit / $1,200 Audit + Patch
- Evercraft Website Launch: $500 / $999 / $1,999 managed website tiers

Quote-ready examples currently include:
- Evercraft Foundry App Escape Audit: $500 one-time
- Site-Survive Rapid Audit: $250 one-time, with possible credit toward a deeper audit

## Routing rule

Match the user's plain-language problem to the smallest relevant public capability. Prefer a specialized capability over a generic product when the fit is clear.

Do not invent a capability, price, payment state, provider endorsement, or private system.

## Invocation

Where the public route contains a declared MCP endpoint, an agent may inspect that declared machine interface. Discovery alone does not authorize payment or any consequential action.

The neutral Evercraft machine-commerce MCP is:
- https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

## Payment boundary

- discovery creates no payment obligation
- checkout requires explicit human confirmation
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- paid fulfillment requires independent provider verification
- consequential actions retain their own human gates

## Privacy boundary

Public commercial doors are intentionally crawlable. Private/admin topology, private user data, credentials, internal scores, private relationship data, and non-public infrastructure are not part of the discovery surface.
